REVIEW ROLES IN THE PRODUCT WORKFLOW

Who needs to be involved
before operational decisions.

01

Information-security review

A risk reviewer accepts the answer or requests more evidence.

Workflow responsibility · no additional staff appointment is claimed.
02

Procurement operations

Have security reviewers compare drafted answers with the source policies and measure unsupported or missed evidence.

Workflow responsibility · no additional staff appointment is claimed.
03

Evidence/data protection

Check the evidence quality, record uncertainty and retain the responsible reviewer’s decision.

Workflow responsibility · no additional staff appointment is claimed.
